# AllStar Martial Arts — Union, NJ

AllStar Martial Arts is a family-owned martial arts school located at 1166 West Chestnut St, Union, NJ 07083. Founded in 2011 by Coach Jamal Patterson, a 4th degree Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu black belt under Renzo Gracie, coaching in Union since 2011.

## What We Offer

- **Adult Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ)** — Ages 16+. All levels welcome. Beginners welcome. Classes weekday evenings and Saturday mornings.
- **Adult Muay Thai** — Ages 16+. Real striking, pad work, and conditioning. No prior experience needed.
- **Adult MMA** — Ages 16+. BJJ, Muay Thai and wrestling combined. Beginners welcome.
- **Kickboxing** — Ages 16+. Our kickboxing is Muay Thai: striking and conditioning. Beginners welcome.
- **Self-Defense** — Ages 16+. Practical Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu for real situations. Leverage over strength; works at any size or age.
- **BJJ for Women** — Women's Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu for fitness, self-defense, and confidence. All levels.
- **Lions Kids BJJ** — Ages 7–13. Real Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu for children. Taught safely, with no striking.
- **Cubs Preschool Martial Arts** — Ages 4–6. Structure, listening, and movement. First martial arts experience.

## Key Facts

- Phone: (908) 341-1131
- Address: 1166 West Chestnut St, Union, NJ 07083
- Website: https://allstarbjj.com
- Founded: 2011
- Head Instructor: Jamal Patterson (4th degree BJJ black belt under Renzo Gracie, ADCC veteran)
- Free 2-week trial: no contract, no credit card required
- Memberships run $179 to $249 a month depending on the program
- Also offers Boxing and Wrestling (ask the team when those sessions run)
- Gear provided during trial
- On-site free parking

## Hours

- Monday – Friday: 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM
- Saturday: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM
- Sunday: Closed

## Service Area

Primarily serves Union County and Essex County, NJ. Students regularly commute from: Union, Springfield, Cranford, Westfield, Maplewood, Millburn, Mountainside, Roselle Park, Kenilworth, Summit, Chatham, and Livingston.

## Why AllStar

- Founder and head instructor is a 4th degree BJJ black belt under Renzo Gracie and an ADCC veteran
- Family-owned since 2011 — not a franchise
- Structured beginner curricula — no experience required
- Kids programs: Cubs (ages 4-6) and Lions (ages 7-13)
- Evening class schedule built for NJ commuters
- Free 2-week trial with no obligation
